name: darkest_den
comment: Den of Evil arena: our own copy of the Pit level 2 room (Blizzard's act1/caves/caveroom5, 24x24 tiles), a round cave, with walls along the edge of its open floor so the automap shows the boundary ('edge_walls'; cave rooms have no straight walls, so they come from a cave theme room). The waypoint stands in the north-west, where the Pit's stairs come in; the fight comes from the south-east. Its treasure chests are left out. (0.13.1 to 0.17.31 cut a round hall out of the four-way room cavensew instead, but that room's HD ground is corridors with rock between them, so parts of the hall showed as missing floor.)

extra_objects.comment: WaypointOutsideAct1 (objpreset Act 1 Index 52). Its HD look is the prefab below, placed as in the game's act1/outdoors/waypoint map (object at sub-tile 14,14 -> prefab at 37,38).
